question: Should every Android use of the shared segmented control wrap when it has more than four options, or should the two-row layout be owned specifically by Skill Workshop?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but repository evidence does not establish whether a count-based wrapping threshold is the intended app-wide design-system contract.

options.title: Adopt shared wrapping
options.body: Approve wrapping above four options as the shared contract, refresh onto current main, and verify all current callers before merge.

options.title: Scope to Skill Workshop
options.body: Preserve the shared control’s one-row contract and implement the demonstrated two-row behavior at the Skill Workshop caller.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Approve wrapping above four options as the shared contract, refresh onto current main, and verify all current callers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app maintainer, and this choice governs an app-wide shared UI component.
